notes.title: Rulegement Became Visible on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi,

Rulegement, my management/simulation game that I have been working on for a very short time, is now visible on Steam. This will be the first game I will develop. I can say that I have good ideas in my mind.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/b3vrvdy/Frame-27-1.png[/img]

After advancing the development process of the game for a while, Rulegement will be available as a playtest for everyone to try and express their opinions in October/November. Participation in the Playtest will be free. I think your ideas are very valuable and meaningful to make the game fun. The development process will be based on feedback in many ways.

To share your ideas with us, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/EUK8rYsCQC]Discord[/url] address.
